newsitem.title: UK: Specials at centre stage on UK gilt repo mkt.
newsitem.headline: Specials at centre stage on UK gilt repo mkt.

text.p: The same handful of special stocks dominated business in the UK gilt repo market, with interest centred in the one-month period, but the week got off to a fairly quiet start, traders said.
Cash rates tightened briefly towards the close as the shortage was left partly uncovered. Operators showed little enthusiasm for selling bills to the Bank of England.
The 8.0 percent gilts due 2003 were quoted at around 50 points through the one-month general collateral level of 5.70 65, a narrower margin than was seen late last week.
The 7.0 percent gilts due 2001 were quoted at between 5.40 and 5.25 percent for one-month, with the 6.0 percent gilts due 1999 at similar levels.
The 7-1/4 gilts due 1998 were quoted at 5.45 percent.
"It has not been a particularly active day, fairly easy on the short dates," one trader said.
Overnight GC was quoted as high as 6.10 percent, having started out in the morning at around 5.85 75.
The Bank of England said it provided assistance totalling 520 million stg after forecasting a liquidity shortage of around 800 million.
Overnight cash touched highs around 7.0 6-1/2 percent before settling back to 5-13/16 3/4, little changed from Friday's late quotes.
